answered.sql: SELECT t7.level_name, COUNT(*) AS number_of_jobs FROM Job_Post AS t1 JOIN Degree_Level AS t7 ON t1.degree_level_id = t7.id GROUP BY t7.level_name

candidates.meaning: Display a list of qualifications (certifications) and the number of available jobs for each
candidates.sql: SELECT T1.cert_name AS qualification, COUNT(T2.id) AS number_of_jobs FROM Certification AS T1 JOIN Job_Post AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.certification_id GROUP BY T1.cert_name

candidates.meaning: Display a list of qualifications (certifications and degrees) and the number of available jobs for each qualification.
candidates.sql: SELECT cert_name, COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM Application JOIN Job_Post ON Application.job_post_id = Job_Post.id JOIN Certification ON Job_Post.certification_id = Certification.id GROUP BY cert_name UNION SELECT level_name, COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM Application JOIN Job_Post ON Application.job_post_id = Job_Post.id JOIN Degree_Level ON Job_Post.degree_level_id = Degree_Level.id GROUP BY level_name

candidates.meaning: Display a list of job titles and the number of available jobs for each title.
candidates.sql: SELECT title, COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM Job_Post GROUP BY title

candidates.meaning: Display a list of companies and the number of available jobs for each company.
candidates.sql: SELECT company_name, COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM Job_Post JOIN Company ON Job_Post.company_id = Company.id GROUP BY company_name
